speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To better understand your condition, could you please describe the location and severity of your flank pain, and confirm if you are experiencing any changes in your urination, such as frequency or burning sensation?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Are you experiencing any nausea, vomiting, or changes in your urinary habits, such as burning or frequency? Do you have any history of kidney stones or diabetes?

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any difficulty urinating, such as burning, frequency, or noticing blood in your urine? I also need to check if the rash has returned or if you have any swelling in your legs or face.

speaker: Patient
text: I do not have nausea, vomiting, or burning with urination. I also have not noticed a major change in urine color.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the history of a rash with amoxicillin, fever, and flank pain, I suspect acute interstitial nephritis. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis, Serum_Creatinine
